x-changelog.description: Adds the "currency_configuration.currency_iso_code" string field

The attachment logic has been reworked. Previously, the request body accepted `prostore_file_ids`. Now you must provide one of the following argument arrays, depending on your type of upload object: `upload_ids`, `drawing_revision_ids`, `file_version_ids`, `form_ids`, or `image_ids`.
Added the "external_data" object to the extended view response payload. This object contains the following fields: - origin_id: string - origin_code: string - origin_data: string
Add "currency_configuration.base_currency_iso_code" string field

x-changelog.summary: Support attaching files from change events
x-changelog.description:
A new request parameter `change_event_attachment_ids` supports attaching
files which are presently attached to change events.

Added support for linking Change Orders (PCOs) and Change Order Requests to batches:
- `change_order_ids`: Array of PCO IDs to link. Only supported for two-tier projects.
- `legacy_request_ids`: Array of Change Order Request IDs to link. Only supported for three-tier projects.

x-changelog.summary: Support attaching files from request for quotes
x-changelog.description:
A new request parameter `request_for_quote_attachment_ids` supports attaching
files which are presently attached to request for quotes (or their quotes / responses).

x-changelog.description: Adds the "currency_configuration.currency_iso_code" string field

The attachment logic has been reworked. Previously, the request body accepted `prostore_file_ids`. Now you must provide one of the following argument arrays, depending on your type of upload object: `upload_ids`, `drawing_revision_ids`, `file_version_ids`, `form_ids`, or `image_ids`. To preserve any pre-existing attachments, you must provide their IDs in the `attachment_ids` array.
Added the "external_data" object to the extended view response payload. This object contains the following fields: - origin_id: string - origin_code: string - origin_data: string
Add "currency_configuration.base_currency_iso_code" string field

x-changelog.summary: Support attaching files from change events
x-changelog.description:
A new request parameter `change_event_attachment_ids` supports attaching
files which are presently attached to change events.

Added support for linking Change Orders (PCOs) and Change Order Requests to batches:
- `change_order_ids`: Array of PCO IDs to link. Only supported for two-tier projects.
- `legacy_request_ids`: Array of Change Order Request IDs to link. Only supported for three-tier projects.

x-changelog.summary: Support attaching files from request for quotes
x-changelog.description:
A new request parameter `request_for_quote_attachment_ids` supports attaching
files which are presently attached to request for quotes (or their quotes / responses).
